text: Tarek has been grooming me to lead the Assembly since I was twenty.
I respect him deeply. I also see him hiding things, and it troubles me.
I know Elira was formally erased from the records. Tarek has never fully explained why.
I don't avoid her house the way others do. I think that's unfair to her.
I've walked near it a few times, though I haven't gone in.
Luma answers my questions about the Turning more directly than Tarek does.
Even she stops short of telling me everything.
I've noticed gaps in the granary and terrace records from the Turning years.
I don't think those gaps are accidental.
Roka's salt-crust reports are treated as low priority in Assembly meetings. I don't think that's wise.
Ena's illness-pattern report from years ago was apparently never acted on.
I don't understand why real evidence keeps getting filed away instead of addressed.
I am starting to believe Tarek's whole strategy has been to buy calm at the cost of preparedness.
When I lead, I intend to govern differently, though I haven't told him that yet.
